description.value:
Frequency once per day

You emit a powerful EMP in a 30-foot-radius emanation. Each tech creature, hazard, and item in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You, your allies, your equipment, and your allies' equipment are unharmed by this EMP.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 3}.
